question: If 32% of 22.5 − (2)/(3) × sqrt[3]{512} × sqrt{81} = y, then the value of y is:
solution:
Given:

32% of 22.5 − (2)/(3) × sqrt[3]{512} × sqrt{81} = y

Concept used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eafd54de9d9fc295c072d1fa0b8367ee3ed24189b7ad133a51c29266134693c4.png] 

Calculation:

32% of 22.5 − (2)/(3) × sqrt[3]{512} × sqrt{81}

⇒ (0.32 of 22.5) − (2)/(3) × sqrt[3]{512} × sqrt{81}

⇒ 7.2 - (2)/(3) × 8 × 9

⇒ 7.2 - 48

⇒ - 40.8

⇒ y

∴ The value of y is -40.8.
